description: Search the supplier directory. No sign-in required. Returns published company profiles only, including profiles a company has claimed. These are not lots for sale. A profile is compiled from public sources and is not an endorsement. Use search_inventory to find lots you can buy. Filter with query, country, type (3pl, returns_processor, brand_retailer, liquidator, other), or category.

category.description: One category the profile lists, such as apparel or electronics.

country.description: Country name or 2-letter code, matched exactly.

query.description: Words to match against the company name, city, or summary.

name: search_suppliers
title: Search suppliers
